SHARE.subject: CRWD (0xea72Ecca2d0f6bFA1394DBBCff85b52CD4233931)
SHARE.affectedParty: Any integrator that presents CRWD balanceOf() as a share count. The contract itself is behaving as ERC-8056 specifies and is not at fault.
SHARE.title: CRWD: reading balanceOf() as shares understates by 75.0000% (multiplier 4.000000000x)
SHARE.statement: CRWD reports uiMultiplier() = 4000000000000000000 (4.000000000), which is CORRECT AND SPEC-COMPLIANT behaviour under ERC-8056 — this finding is not a defect in the token contract. It records the exposure carried by a caller that reads balanceOf() as shares. Under ERC-8056 a corporate action moves the multiplier rather than balances, so balanceOf() returns tokens and share-equivalents = balance * uiMultiplier() / 1e18. A surface presenting the raw balance as a share count understates it by 75.0000% (the true count is 4.0000x the raw balance). Token value computed as balance * Chainlink feed price is unaffected, because the feed is already multiplier-adjusted.

impact.measures: how far a raw balanceOf() read as shares understates the true share count, as a share of the true count
impact.note: totalSupply raw 14.1875 tokens vs 56.7500 share-equivalents (delta 42.5625). Presenting the raw balance as a share count understates by 75.0000%; equivalently the true count is 4.0000x the raw.

CROSS.subject: SGOV (0x92FD66527192E3e61d4DDd13322Aa222DE86F9B5)
CROSS.affectedParty: Any caller that values SGOV with an off-chain SHARE price, or computes a premium/discount between the on-chain token price and an off-chain share price.
CROSS.title: SGOV: off-chain share price and on-chain token price differ by 0.510%
CROSS.statement: The Chainlink feed returns a multiplier-adjusted TOKEN price (101.1277), while Robinhood's REST /prices endpoint returns the RAW UNDERLYING share price (mid 100.6150). These are different quantities related by uiMultiplier(): underlying x 1.005101770 = 101.1283, leaving a residual of -0.001% against the observed feed price. That residual is small relative to the 0.510% multiplier effect, consistent with bid/ask spread and the timing gap between the REST quote and the feed's updatedAt. The finding stands on the multiplier relationship itself, which is byte-verified: valuing balanceOf() with an off-chain share price, or computing a premium/discount between an on-chain token price and an off-chain share price, produces a phantom error of 0.510%.

impact.measures: how far the on-chain token price differs from the off-chain share price, as a share of the share price

offChainSources.describes: underlying share bid/ask used for the mid 100.6150 (not multiplier-adjusted)
